reservoir_states — CONNGRAPH reservoir op

• Data kinds: conn_graph × matrix → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.reservoir_states(W: 'Any', U: 'Any', in_scale: 'float' = 1.0, leak: 'float' = 1.0, nonlinearity: 'str' = 'tanh', seed: 'int' = 0, washout: 'int' = 0, W_in: 'Any' = None) -> 'np.ndarray' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import conngraph; conngraph.reservoir_states(W: 'Any', U: 'Any', in_scale: 'float' = 1.0, leak: 'float' = 1.0, nonlinearity: 'str' = 'tanh', seed: 'int' = 0, washout: 'int' = 0, W_in: 'Any' = None) -> 'np.ndarray', registry से लेना हो तो opsconngraph.get("reservoir_states"))

उपयोग

reservoir की state श्रृंखला: x_{t+1} = (1−leak) x_t + leak · f(Wᵀ x_t + W_in u_t)। (T − washout, n) लौटाता है।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

U は (T, d) の入力列(1-D は (T, 1))。W_in は seed で決まる一様 (−in_scale, in_scale) の (n, d) 行列。nonlinearity は tanh / linear。x_0 = 0 から始め、各ステップの更新後の状態を並べる。washout 行を先頭から捨てる(T 以上は拒否)。

W_in を渡すと乱数の代わりにその (n, d) 行列を使う(in_scale / seed は無視)—— 決まったノード群に刺激を入れる(列 = 刺激するノードの指示子)のはこちら。
